item.title: Weekly Reports
item.description:
My aim is to write up, in LaTeX, a full report of my reading and any results I have obtained between each meeting with my supervisor. This should then provide a comprehensive source to use when it comes to writing my final dissertation. I will provide links to all the PDFs as I go:

  • Week 1 (05/10/25 - 11/10/25)

item.title: Rough Notes
item.description:
Introduction

This page will be used to keep some (as full as possible) documentation of my hand-written note taking throughout this project. This will be on a range of media; my preferred canvas is usually a blackboard or on my iPad.

One will probably not be able to follow these notes as in the way you would a usual course, but I hope you may find some help in seeing how I went about the reading for my dissertation.
